transcript: AC overflow call at Dr. Kenneth Vance, 812 Orchard Court. Attic air handler primary drain clogged and float switch tripped. Cleared the drain line with nitrogen flush. Installed a new Little Giant automatic condensate pump with safety overflow switch. Ran thirty feet of three-eighths inch vinyl discharge tubing out to the exterior soffit. Labor was two and a half hours in the hot attic. Condensate pump is ninety-five dollars.

expected.job_summary: Attic air handler drain line flush and condensate pump installation
expected.notes: Work completed in attic; ran vinyl tube to exterior soffit.
